findings.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager CVE-2026-20245 — Unpatched Zero-Day Active Exploitation Yielding Root Command Execution, Seventh SD-WAN Zero-Day of 2026
findings.affected_technology: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (formerly vManage); all currently shipping versions, no patch available; SD-WAN management plane / vManage HTTPS administrative interface
findings.summary: Cisco issued an emergency advisory on 2026-06-05 for unpatched CVE-2026-20245 in Catalyst SD-WAN Manager confirming active in-the-wild exploitation yielding unauthenticated root command execution on the SD-WAN control plane; seventh SD-WAN zero-day Cisco has confirmed in 2026.

findings.title: IronWorm npm Supply-Chain Worm — Rust Infostealer with eBPF Kernel Rootkit and Tor C2 Self-Propagating via npm Trusted Publishing OIDC Across 36 Packages
findings.affected_technology: npm registry; 36 trojanized packages published from compromised asteroiddao account; targets OpenAI / Anthropic / AWS / npm / SSH / crypto-wallet secrets across 86 env vars + 20 credential files; abuses npm Trusted Publishing OIDC workflow for self-propagation
findings.summary: JFrog disclosed IronWorm on 2026-06-04 — a Rust-based npm worm with an eBPF kernel rootkit, Tor C2, and novel self-propagation via stolen npm Trusted Publishing OIDC tokens that re-publish trojanized package versions automatically; 36 packages contaminated, third Wave-2-class npm worm in 30 days.

findings.title: Everest Forms Pro WordPress Plugin CVE-2026-3300 (CVSS 9.8) — Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Calculation Addon eval() Injection, Active Mass Exploitation
findings.affected_technology: Everest Forms Pro WordPress plugin, Calculation Addon, all versions ≤ 1.9.12; patched in 1.9.13; affects any site rendering a form with the Calculation Addon enabled
findings.summary: Everest Forms Pro Calculation Addon concatenates user-submitted form field values into a PHP code string and passes it directly to eval() yielding unauthenticated RCE; active mass exploitation reported by Wordfence telemetry per THN 2026-06-05; fourth active-exploit WordPress plugin disclosure in 8 days.

findings.title: SolarWinds Serv-U CVE-2026-28318 — KEV-Added with 2026-06-19 Federal Deadline, Active Exploitation of Unauth Resource-Exhaustion DoS via Content-Encoding: deflate POST
findings.affected_technology: SolarWinds Serv-U file transfer platform (HTTP/HTTPS/FTP/FTPS/SFTP) prior to 15.5.4 Hotfix 1; ~12,000 internet-exposed instances per Shodan
findings.summary: CISA added SolarWinds Serv-U CVE-2026-28318 to the KEV catalog on 2026-06-05 with a 2026-06-19 federal deadline after confirmed in-the-wild exploitation of unauthenticated resource-consumption DoS triggered by Content-Encoding: deflate POST requests; SolarWinds shipped Serv-U 15.5.4 Hotfix 1 the same day.

findings.title: Cisco Unified Communications Manager CVE-2026-20230 (CVSS 8.6) — Unauthenticated SSRF → Arbitrary File Write → Root Privilege Escalation, Public PoC Released
findings.affected_technology: Cisco Unified Communications Manager with the WebDialer Web Service enabled (default off); fixed in 14SU6 and 15SU5
findings.summary: Cisco disclosed CVE-2026-20230 in Unified CM on 2026-06-04 — an unauthenticated SSRF in the WebDialer service enabling file writes to disk and root privilege escalation; public PoC released within 24 hours but no in-wild exploitation confirmed yet; WebDialer is disabled by default, limiting blast radius.

findings.title: Polyfill.io Domain Takeover Round 2 — Toshiba, Muji, Samsung Smart TVs and Multiple Japanese Brands Serving Fake Login Prompts via HTTP 401 on Legacy Script References
findings.affected_technology: Web pages with legacy polyfill[.]io / cdn.polyfill[.]io script references; affected brands include Toshiba, Muji, Zojirushi, FiNC Technologies, Ishiyaku Publishers, Hobonichi, Samsung Smart TVs
findings.summary: Following 2024's polyfill.io Chinese-entity compromise, the domain changed hands again and the new owner is responding with HTTP 401 challenges that surface browser-native auth prompts on every legacy-referencing page; Toshiba, Muji and Samsung have advised users to ignore prompts and rotate credentials.

findings.title: UNC5221 / VerdantBamboo 'Brickstorm' — 18-Month Edge-Device Persistence Campaign via Egnyte and SSL-VPN Zero-Days, Plenet + AgentPSD Secondary Implants
findings.affected_technology: Edge devices and storage-sync (Egnyte); Microsoft 365 environments; victim sectors: legal services, SaaS providers, BPOs, technology companies, primarily US-based; MSP infrastructure abused for lateral movement
findings.summary: Volexity disclosed a UNC5221 / VerdantBamboo campaign on 2026-06-05 in which the Golang/Rust Brickstorm WebSocket implant — plus Plenet .NET shell-and-file backdoor and AgentPSD Python reverse-shell fallback — maintained persistence on edge devices for 18+ months undetected before infrastructure went dark in mid-September 2025 and reactivated in 2026.

findings.title: PCPJack — 230 AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure Servers Hijacked into Covert SMTP Relay Network Verified for Mail Delivery Every Five Minutes
findings.affected_technology: ~230 compromised public-cloud-tenant servers across AWS, GCP, Azure (US/Europe/Asia); operator C2 at 213.136.80[.]73
findings.summary: Hunt.io documented the PCPJack operation on 2026-06-05 — ~230 cloud-tenant servers compromised across the three major hyperscalers and converted into authenticated SMTP relays verified for mail delivery every 5 minutes; initially flagged by SentinelOne in April 2026 as a cloud-credential-theft framework, now operationalized at scale.

findings.title: CPython CVE-2026-7774 — tarfile.data_filter Path-Traversal Bypass Allowing Writes Outside the Extraction Directory
findings.affected_technology: CPython tarfile module (full version matrix pending); 3.12+ default data_filter and pre-3.12 backports; downstream blast radius includes pip/wheel installers, ML model-weights loaders, CI artifact extractors, container runtimes
findings.summary: Oss-security 2026-06-04 disclosed CVE-2026-7774 — a path-traversal bypass in CPython's tarfile.data_filter sandbox allowing writes outside the intended extraction directory; broad blast radius via pip/wheel, ML model-distribution pipelines, and CI artifact extraction.

findings.title: TA4922 / Atlas RAT Campaign — RomulusLoader and SilentRunLoader Added to Tooling, Target-Geography UK/DE/IT/SA Confirmed (Material Tooling Expansion)
findings.affected_technology: Same as 2026-06-04 entry — Windows endpoints in UK/Germany/Italy/South Africa receiving localized payroll/tax/VAT/HR phishing lures; adds new loader families RomulusLoader and SilentRunLoader alongside Atlas RAT and ValleyRAT
findings.summary: THN 2026-06-05 expands the 2026-06-04 TA4922 (Silver Fox / Void Arachne overlap) coverage with two new loader families RomulusLoader and SilentRunLoader running alongside Atlas RAT; threat score holds at 4 but defenders should treat existing IOC sets as incomplete and re-ingest the new tooling indicators.

noted.product: Chrome 149 — 429 vulnerabilities patched, 22 critical including CVE-2026-10881 ANGLE OOB write sandbox-escape (CVSS 9.6, $97K bounty) and CVE-2026-11282 sandbox escape on Linux
noted.summary: Chrome 149 patches 429 vulnerabilities including 22 critical sandbox-escape and use-after-free flaws; browser client OOS for direct corporate defense but Linux sandbox bypass relevant to dev-workstation patch cadence; no in-wild exploitation flagged.

noted.summary: Israeli VPN/proxy browser Hola for Windows was compromised in its distribution channel and shipped a Monero miner persisting via a Windows service plus a Defender exclusion rule; ~0.1% of userbase impacted per vendor.

noted.product: Mirasvit Magento Full Page Cache Warmer — Unauthenticated PHP-object-deserialization RCE on Magento / Adobe Commerce servers (SW 2026-06-04)
noted.summary: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer extension contains an unauthenticated PHP-object-deserialization RCE primitive exploitable on Magento/Adobe Commerce stores; no CVE assigned yet, vendor patch ETA pending.

noted.product: Stripe-as-payload-host Magecart campaign — skimmer JS hosted in Stripe customer-metadata field at cus_TfFjAAZQNOYENR loaded via Google Tag Manager (Sansec)
noted.summary: Magecart operators host skimmer JavaScript in a Stripe customer-metadata record and load it via Google Tag Manager bypassing CSP via trusted domains; Firestore variant uses braintree-payment-app project; durable pattern of payment-processor APIs as CSP-trusted skimmer hosts.

noted.product: OP-512 — Fourth China-aligned IIS-targeting threat cluster in 12 months (ReliaQuest 2026-06-05)
noted.summary: ReliaQuest disclosed OP-512, a previously unreported China-linked cluster deploying a custom IIS web-shell framework for espionage; joins CL-STA-0048 / DragonRank / GhostRedirector as the fourth China-aligned IIS-targeting actor in 12 months.

noted.summary: Joint CISA KEV announcement reaffirms Android CVE-2025-48595 plus Linux CVE-2022-0492 active exploitation; Linux entry was Watchtower 2026-06-04 HIGH; Android is mobile-only OOS and was already in 2026-06-03 / 2026-06-04 Noted.

noted.summary: Day-two coverage of the 2026-06-04 CRITICAL ATG joint advisory adds Shadowserver scan numbers showing 909 US-located ATG systems exposed; no new vendor or CVE info, scope-confirmation only.
